In [[7000 BBY]],<ref name="TOR Encyclopedia" /> an [[army]] of [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]], having built a fleet of spacecraft and declared war on the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]],<ref name="SWSotS">''[[Star Wars: Secrets of the Sith]]''</ref> launched an '''assault''' on the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. The attack marked the beginning of the [[Hundred-Year Darkness/Legends|Hundred-Year Darkness]].<ref name="TOR Encyclopedia" />
